white-oak slat media wall with limestone ledge, linear fireplace and record shelves
frontal open stud wall with plumbing stub-outs and floor drain, work light; rainy evening
charcoal smoked-oak wet bar with soapstone counter, reeded-glass uppers, backlit bottle shelves
low view: framed alcove under egress window well, capped sconce wires; midday overcast
birch-plywood built-in guest bed alcove with brass reading lamps and ferns in the window well
view from basement stairs: open framing under the stairs, drywall stack; grey afternoon
walnut desk and stepped shelves built in under the stairs, banker's lamp
primed wall with raw arched stud recess, bucket and mud pan; golden sun through garden door
oxblood-red lacquered library wall with backlit arched wine niche and brass ladder
wide view: taped drywall with framed niche, rosin paper floor, sawhorse; blue hour
fog-grey home-gym storage wall with center mirror, hemlock slats and bench

idea: Six unfinished basements mid-remodel in 1920s Portland craftsman bungalows hard-cut into six finished built-in walls (white-oak media wall, charcoal wet bar, birch guest-bed alcove, under-stair walnut desk, oxblood lacquer library on the climax, fog-grey home-gym wall).
